title: April 10, 2026: Top 5 AI News For Today!
description:
AI is evolving fast—and today’s updates prove it’s getting more expensive, more powerful, and more integrated into everyday life.

In this video, we break down the Top 5 AI News for April 10 in simple terms:
 • OpenAI introduces a new $100/month ChatGPT plan
 • Claude becomes enterprise-ready for businesses
 • Alibaba’s viral text-to-video AI model takes the top spot
 • Perplexity launches a personal finance dashboard with Plaid
 • AI agents now handle over 30% of deployments

From pricing wars to AI managing your money and even replacing parts of developer workflows, this is where AI is heading right now.

If you’re trying to stay ahead in AI, business, or tech—this is what you need to know.

Subscribe for daily AI updates in plain English
transcript: AI just got more expensive, more powerful, and more personal. Here's the top five for today. First, OpenAI just dropped a new $100 a month ChatGPT plan. It sits between its $20 and $200 tier, basically targeting power users who want more performance without going all in. Translation, AI pricing is starting a tier like Netflix, but for intelligence. Two, Claude just became enterprise-ready. Companies can now control who uses it, track usage, manage spending, so AI isn't just a tool anymore. It's becoming a full-on workspace. Three, Alibaba dropped a new text-to-video model that's currently topping leaderboards. This thing turns text into realistic videos, and it's going viral in China. APIs are coming soon for this, which means creators and businesses are about to tap into this. Four, Perplexity just launched a personal finance dashboard. You can connect your bank, credit cards, loans, everything. It tracks spending, net worth, and gives insights. AI is officially becoming your financial assistant. And five, new data shows AI agents are now doing 30% of deployments on some platforms, meaning AI isn't just helping developers. It's starting to act like one. AI isn't slowing down. It's getting deeper into your work, your money, and your daily life. That's your top five AI for today.
